title: Contents Packout & Storage Air-Ride Truck Percentage for High-Value Returns
content:
High-value Contents Packout & Storage contents ride home in an air-ride truck. On the move-back truck line of a return: **when the high-value inventory item quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the air-ride volume threshold, the truck trip fee carries the large air-ride percentage; when they total at least one but fewer than the air-ride volume threshold, it carries the small air-ride percentage; a job with no high-value inventory item carries no air-ride percentage.**

| High-value inventory items on the job's packout lines | Air-ride percentage on the truck trip fee |
|---|---|
| 25 or more (at least the air-ride volume threshold) | 12 percent |
| 1 to 24 | 8 percent |
| none | none |

**Boundary cases.** 24 items: 8 percent. 25 items: 12 percent. On a trip fee taken as 100.00 for illustration, those give 108.00 and 112.00 per load.
